indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: A business account receives more than one ERC check deposit over multiple days.
indicators.red_flag: Multiple Treasury ERC check deposits across consecutive days into one business account
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: Small business accounts receive an ERC check deposit that is not commensurate with the size of the business, the number of employees, and the volume of transactions.
indicators.red_flag: ERC credit size disproportionate to business headcount / transaction volume
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D6 (Check / negotiable-instrument image & metadata), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: A large ERC is deposited into a business account and is subsequently transferred using P2P services or to an online banking institution, or withdrawn as cash at an ATM.  Funds may be subsequently transferred from the account into separate accounts or payments may be made to new businesses that a customer has not had transactions with prior to receiving an ERC check deposit.
indicators.red_flag: ERC deposit immediately swept out via P2P / online-bank / ATM cash to no-relationship payees (pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: The account receiving an ERC check deposit has no deposits other than Treasury-issued checks, or the account has no regular business transactions.
indicators.red_flag: Account funded solely by Treasury checks, no genuine operating activity
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: A customer attempts to deposit an altered Treasury ERC check, or financial institutions are unable to verify the validity of the checks that customers attempt to deposit.
indicators.red_flag: Altered / unverifiable Treasury ERC check presented for deposit
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D6 (Check / negotiable-instrument image & metadata), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: The ERC check is deposited into a new business account that did not exist in 2020 or 2021.
indicators.red_flag: ERC check deposited to account opened after the eligibility period (2020/2021)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: A new business account is created for an established business, but no other business activity occurs in the account except the deposit of the ERC.  This may be indicative of identity theft, where the established business was used as a fraudulent front to file for the ERC.
indicators.red_flag: Single-purpose new account for an established business, ERC-only (identity-theft front)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.source: identity-verification / liveness service + bureau + cross-account PII graph

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: A dormant business account suddenly receives an ERC check deposit.
indicators.red_flag: Dormant business account reactivated by an inbound ERC deposit
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: An ERC is deposited into a business account with no payroll history.
indicators.red_flag: ERC (a payroll-tax credit) deposited to account with no payroll history
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: A customer reports or provides documents indicating that their ERC was obtained by a third-party firm whose credentials cannot be verified or is the subject of adverse media.
indicators.red_flag: ERC obtained via unverifiable / adverse-media third-party filing firm
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of ERC Fraud
indicators.flag: payments may be made to new businesses that a customer has not had transactions with prior to receiving an ERC check deposit
indicators.red_flag: Onward pay-out to no-prior-relationship new-business payees post-ERC (layering fan-out)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).
